content: Better to be without logic than without feeling.
author: Charlotte Brontë
story:
Preserved as part of Charlotte Brontë's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of feeling and love. Across his life and work, Charlotte Brontë returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
